description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeAllowedReportToEmployeeModel class in the OrangeHRM project. The class models data related to an employee that is allowed to report to another employee, including properties such as employee number, name, ID, and termination record ID. It uses traits and implements serialization and normalization interfaces, indicating its role in API data modeling and serialization within the OrangeHRM human resource management system.
